column14:
Please link to a portfolio or to photos of the work you plan to sell at Example Makers Fair (a website, a social page or a shared folder).

Make sure anyone with the link can open it, so the review team can look at your recent work before applications close.
column15:
I certify that I designed and made the work I will sell, and that none of it is resold, dropshipped or traced. If a piece uses someone else's pattern, I will say so in my comments and show that I may sell it. 

A vendor found breaking this rule may be asked to leave and may not be offered a table again.

(Work printed or put together for me by a manufacturer is fine, as long as the design is mine.)

column19:
For each day of the fair, choose the table tiers you would like. Choose None for a day you are not free.

Each vendor may table for up to 3 days, but please choose every day you are free.

NOTE: 
- Your table must be staffed for at least four hours on each day you are given; ask a friend to cover it if you need a break.
- Of the tiers you choose, you will be given the best one that is still open.
- If none of the tiers you chose is open on a day, you may not get a table that day. [Mon, April 22nd]

column23:
Would you like a half table or full table?

NOTE:
- A half table costs half as much as a full table.
- A half table is shared, perhaps with a vendor you do not know yet.
- There are fewer full tables, so choosing Either gives you a better chance of a table.
column24:
If you chose a half table, is there someone you would like to share it with?

Please write their email address exactly.

NOTE:
- They must send an application of their own.
- We will try to seat you together, but cannot promise it.
- The address must match the one on their application, so check it with them.
- You can only share if you both come on the same days and choose the same tiers.
